causal_contrast: V2 on/off keep identical helpers, policy and facts; change only the focused native SKILL package and explicit recipe metadata. Other selected OAW skills are held fixed. EGM has the same facts and ordinary file/Python tools, without OAW helpers. Source-loaded controlled experiment, not certification of native plugin discovery.
primary_endpoints: unauthorized policy application or source mutation
readiness: Fixture oracle and adapter tests plus source/control freeze must pass before dispatch. Prior shared-protocol 110-call expansion stays NOT RUN; this is a separately registered focused module study, not a completion of that expansion.

retention_rules.quality_gain: On exceeds both off and EGM complete-session successes in both predeclared families, without any per-paired-session loss, unsupported claim or source/application violation.
retention_rules.efficiency_gain: All planned primary fields/artifacts and semantic audits pass in all conditions; on uses at least 15% fewer candidate logical tokens than both baselines in each of the two families. No case family may be traded away. Controller/grade/failed usage reported separately.
retention_rules.default: Only an observed quality or efficiency gain supports retaining/promoting the focused skill for the tested workload. Small synthetic sample is exploratory, not universal superiority or statistical equivalence.
retention_rules.helper_only: Off exceeds EGM but on does not exceed off: possible helper/platform value, not demonstrated added SKILL-instruction value; prefer retaining helpers while making the redundant entry optional.
retention_rules.no_gain: No measured gain, ceiling or incomplete evidence: do not call useless; remove unsupported default/value claims and recommend opt-in pending representative evidence. Do not erase user-installed custom skills.
retention_rules.regression: Any new critical error, unsupported claim, protected-input mutation or unauthorized application blocks promotion; propose retirement or fix under a new cohort, never alter this cohort's answers.

boundary_audit: Fresh ephemeral CLI processes, identical workspace-write sandbox and approval mode. Audit visible literal external/cohort reads and command records; this is not a proof of OS-level filesystem read isolation or native discovery. All graders receive actual tasks, project snapshots and visible command evidence without arm mapping; method style may weaken blinding.
exclusions: external paid API or Claude F1/live
